description: Farmland Soil, Water & Drought Report — Before buying, leasing or planting a US parcel, reads the USDA NRCS soil survey at a point (lat/lon or US address): map unit, prime farmland class, land capability class and subclass, drainage, hydric rating, flooding and ponding frequency, water table and bedrock depth, slope, pH, organic matter, available water capacity (percent-weighted across components) and building-site ratings with shrink-s

address.description: US street address, geocoded by the US Census geocoder.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude. Give lat with lon, or address.

use.description: Intended use to rate. Omit to rate all four.

name: farmland-soil-report
